hook: Your logo is not your brand. Your brand is what people say about you when you leave the room.
direction: Logo = symbol; brand = reputation, promise, consistency. Orgs polish the mark and neglect the message. For a church, the "brand" is the community's testimony — protect that first.

facebook.text:
Your logo is not your brand. Your brand is what people say about you when you leave the room.

A logo is a symbol. Your brand is your reputation — the promise you make and whether you keep it, consistently, over time.

A lot of organizations spend real money polishing the mark and almost nothing protecting the message. For a church, that's backwards. The most powerful thing you have isn't your wordmark. It's the testimony of your community. Guard that first. Let the logo follow.
